title: Autoware Index validation history record
description: Schema for one NDJSON line in history/<distro>/<package>.ndjson on the orphan data branch. Append-only. This is the EMIT contract (record schema 2): lines written before the schema-2 cutover carry no 'schema' field and lack repository/repo_name — readers treat those as schema 1 and must stay permissive; old lines are never rewritten.

schema.description: Record format version. Absent on pre-cutover (v1) lines.

sweep_kind.description: eager = the repository entry changed on main (level-triggered against data:state/). nightly = daily branch-tip re-test. (The dropped 'release' mode is subsumed by the runtime autoware-version resolver.)

ref_at_test.description: The repository's registered ref at the moment of testing. Captured so swapping the registration later doesn't make old records ambiguous. Mirrors distribution.schema.json#/$defs/ref but inlined so this schema validates offline.

resolved_sha.description: Actual commit sha tested. For kind=branch, this is the tip the sweep's clone resolved. Sibling packages swept in the same repository row share one resolved_sha by construction.

status.description: pass = this package's own dependency-closure build AND its own tests succeeded at this repo@sha. fail = its closure failed to build or its own tests failed. A sibling package's tests never affect this status. Inconclusive outcomes are skipped loudly, never recorded.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the test concluded.

actions_run_url.description: Link to the GitHub Actions run that produced this record.

repository.description: Git URL of the repository the package was registered from at test time. With resolved_sha + actions_run_url this makes same-event sibling records exactly groupable and repo migrations recoverable from history.

repo_name.description: Registry key of the repository entry at test time.
